reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 14.8 addresses only each party's supervision of its own personnel, IBM's assignment rights and subcontracting, while § 14.16 merely permits similar agreements with others — neither imposes a non-solicit, no-hire or inducement restriction on the Customer.
This matches the playbook preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so no redline or counterparty comment is warranted; the absence of edits and comment is correct for a compliant finding.

The failed deterministic sub-checks (12-month cap, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; the rationale correctly explains this rather than fabricating a restriction.

Redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs, so there is no directional or drafting error to review; the reviewer note about unreviewed Order Forms/attachments is a reasonable, clearly-labelled caveat and does not change the verdict.
